---
title: "About This Website"
---

My portfolio represents my learning over the course of the semester. I focused mainly on improving my visualization skills in ggplot, using data from my own work as well as from outside sources like Tidy Tuesday. In the process, I also got practice with data cleaning/transformation/simulation and tried some new packages (e.g., rempsyc, DiagrammeR) to create visualizations outside of ggplot. I look forward to applying and developing these skills further in my future work!
